运行前的观察目标

训练与验证 MSE 逐步降低；最终验证 MSE 小于 0.01，并打印通过。确切小数可能随 PyTorch 版本略有差异。

python 38_training-loop_demo.py环境配置

训练合成双输出回归模型，严格汇总验证误差

38_training-loop_demo.py
# [1] 独立的合成训练集与验证集import torchfrom torch import nnfrom torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDatasettorch.manual_seed(19)true_weight = torch.randn(4, 2)x = torch.randn(173, 4)y = x @ true_weight + 0.2 + 0.01 * torch.randn(173, 2)train_loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(x[:128], y[:128]),                          batch_size=24, shuffle=True, num_workers=0)val_loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(x[128:], y[128:]),                        batch_size=16, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)model = nn.Linear(4, 2)optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.03, weight_decay=0) # [2] 按元素总数汇总，保存并恢复模型原来的模式def evaluate(model, loader):    was_training = model.training    model.eval()    error_sum, count = 0.0, 0    with torch.no_grad():        for inputs, targets in loader:            errors = (model(inputs) - targets).square()            error_sum += errors.sum().item()            count += errors.numel()    model.train(was_training)    return error_sum / count # [3] 清零、前向、反向、有限性检查、裁剪、更新for epoch in range(80):    model.train()    train_sum, train_count = 0.0, 0    for inputs, targets in train_loader:        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)        errors = (model(inputs) - targets).square()        loss = errors.mean()        assert torch.isfinite(loss), "发现非有限 loss"        loss.backward()        grad_norm = nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=10.0)        assert torch.isfinite(grad_norm), "发现非有限梯度"        optimizer.step()        train_sum += errors.detach().sum().item()        train_count += errors.numel()    if epoch in (0, 19, 79):        print(epoch, "train MSE", round(train_sum/train_count, 6),              "val MSE", round(evaluate(model, val_loader), 6))assert evaluate(model, val_loader) < 0.01print("训练循环与验证检查通过")

点击行号说明，高亮对应实现。

共同训练项目：从有效样本到累积、精度与完整恢复

复用本课 4→2 线性回归，将 Dataset、DataLoader、有效 Loss、梯度累积、CPU BF16、诊断和 checkpoint 放进一个可执行程序；其他工程课程链接这里的同一函数。

运行时应核对

所有断言通过：微批有效分母为 10 与 30，正确累积与 full batch 的梯度及 SGD 更新在 float64 容差内一致；局部 mean 控制组产生不同梯度。CPU BF16 输出、FP32 参数/梯度和 FP32 归约得到核验，并实际更新参数。epoch 边界恢复后的下一整轮样本顺序、指标、模型和优化状态完全一致。程序打印本次环境与误差；CUDA AMP 未运行，真实 DDP 仍标为 environment_blocked。

training-loop_shared-training-project.py
"""一个连续训练案例：同一数据、模型、有效位和目标贯穿全部验证。 运行：python training-shared-project.py（只需 PyTorch，使用 CPU）。本例选择可实现的 4→2 线性回归，隔离训练工程；不表示机器人策略。"""import copyimport ioimport jsonfrom contextlib import nullcontextfrom itertools import islice import torchfrom torch import nnfrom torch.nn.utils.rnn import pad_sequencefrom torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader  # 01 数据：每个 episode 是一条变长序列，不把 Padding 当真实零值。class ToyEpisodes(Dataset):    def __init__(self, count=44, seed=211):        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)        scale = torch.tensor([1., 10., .1, 3.])        weight = torch.tensor([[.7, -.1], [-.3, .6], [.5, .2], [.2, -.4]])        self.items = []        for index in range(count):            length = [1, 4, 2, 5, 3][index % 5]            features = torch.randn(length, 4, generator=generator)            target = features @ weight + torch.tensor([.2, -.4])            target += .01 * torch.randn(length, 2, generator=generator)            self.items.append({"id": index, "x": features * scale, "y": target})     def __len__(self):        return len(self.items)     def __getitem__(self, index):        return self.items[index]  def collate_episodes(items):    if not items or any(len(item["x"]) == 0 for item in items):        raise ValueError("本例拒绝空 Batch 或空 episode")    lengths = torch.tensor([len(item["x"]) for item in items])    x = pad_sequence([item["x"] for item in items], batch_first=True,                     padding_value=float("nan"))    y = pad_sequence([item["y"] for item in items], batch_first=True,                     padding_value=float("nan"))    valid = torch.arange(x.shape[1])[None, :] < lengths[:, None]    return {"x": x, "y": y, "valid": valid,            "ids": [item["id"] for item in items]}  def fit_statistics(train_items):    # 只访问训练切分的真实 token，不从补齐后的数组估计统计量。    x = torch.cat([item["x"] for item in train_items])    y = torch.cat([item["y"] for item in train_items])    return {"x_mean": x.mean(0), "x_scale": x.std(0, correction=0).clamp_min(1e-6),            "y_mean": y.mean(0), "y_scale": y.std(0, correction=0).clamp_min(1e-6)}  # 02 模型：沿用训练循环主例的 Linear(4,2)，只增加已定义的状态管理。class TokenRegressor(nn.Module):    def __init__(self, statistics):        super().__init__()        for name, value in statistics.items():            self.register_buffer(name, value.clone())        self.head = nn.Linear(4, 2)     def forward(self, x, valid):        if x.ndim != 3 or valid.dtype != torch.bool or valid.shape != x.shape[:2]:            raise ValueError("需要 [B,T,4] 输入与 bool [B,T] 有效位")        if x.shape[-1] != 4 or not torch.isfinite(x[valid]).all():            raise ValueError("有效输入必须为有限四维特征")        # 在 Linear 之前隔离 NaN；只在 loss 处乘零仍可能污染权重梯度。        clean = x.masked_fill(~valid[..., None], 0)        return self.head((clean - self.x_mean) / self.x_scale)  def masked_error_sum(model, prediction, batch):    target, valid = batch["y"], batch["valid"]    if prediction.shape != target.shape or not valid.any():        raise ValueError("预测/目标必须同形，并且至少有一项监督")    selected = target[valid]  # 先选择，再做减法/平方，不能先计算 NaN 误差。    if not torch.isfinite(selected).all():        raise ValueError("有效标签出现非有限值")    target_normalized = (selected - model.y_mean) / model.y_scale    # BF16 输出在敏感归约之前转 FP32；double 对照则保留 float64。    compute_dtype = torch.float64 if prediction.dtype == torch.float64 else torch.float32    error = prediction[valid].to(compute_dtype) - target_normalized.to(compute_dtype)    return error.square().sum(), error.numel()  def amp_context(enabled):    return torch.autocast("cpu", dtype=torch.bfloat16) if enabled else nullcontext()  # 03 一次更新：分母属于整个累积窗口，不属于单个微批次。def train_window(model, optimizer, batches, scheduler=None, cpu_amp=False):    denominator = sum(int(batch["valid"].sum()) * 2 for batch in batches)    if denominator == 0:        raise ValueError("当前累积窗口没有监督")    model.train()    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    numerator = 0.    before = [p.detach().clone() for p in model.parameters()]    for batch in batches:        with amp_context(cpu_amp):            prediction = model(batch["x"], batch["valid"])        total, _ = masked_error_sum(model, prediction, batch)        assert torch.isfinite(total), "非有限 loss：先审查输入/标签和分母"        (total / denominator).backward()        numerator += total.detach().item()    assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()               for p in model.parameters()), "梯度缺失或非有限"    # 同一窗口只裁剪一次；CPU BF16 不使用 FP16 GradScaler。    grad_norm = nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 10., error_if_nonfinite=True)    optimizer.step()    if scheduler is not None:        scheduler.step()  # 按实际 optimizer update 推进。    displacement = sum((p.detach() - old).square().sum().item()                       for p, old in zip(model.parameters(), before)) ** .5    return {"sum": numerator, "count": denominator,            "grad_norm": float(grad_norm), "update_norm": displacement}  def make_loader(items, generator, shuffle):    return DataLoader(items, batch_size=5, shuffle=shuffle, drop_last=False,                      num_workers=0, collate_fn=collate_episodes, generator=generator)  def train_epoch(model, optimizer, scheduler, loader, update_step, cpu_amp=False):    iterator, sums, counts, order = iter(loader), 0., 0, []    while batches := list(islice(iterator, 2)):        result = train_window(model, optimizer, batches, scheduler, cpu_amp)        sums += result["sum"]        counts += result["count"]        order.extend(index for batch in batches for index in batch["ids"])        update_step += 1    return {"mse": sums / counts, "count": counts, "order": order,            "update_step": update_step}  @torch.no_grad()def evaluate(model, loader):    was_training = model.training    model.eval()    sums, counts = 0., 0    for batch in loader:        prediction = model(batch["x"], batch["valid"])        total, count = masked_error_sum(model, prediction, batch)        sums += total.item()        counts += count    model.train(was_training)  # 本例只有 Linear，没有需要单独恢复的混合模式。    return sums / counts  # 04 从同一状态分叉：full batch 与不等有效长度 microbatch 的更新对照。def verify_accumulation(model, items):    full, accumulated, wrong = [copy.deepcopy(model).double() for _ in range(3)]    def as_double(batch):        return {key: value.double() if key in ("x", "y") else value                for key, value in batch.items()}    whole = as_double(collate_episodes(items[:7]))    parts = [as_double(collate_episodes(items[:2])), as_double(collate_episodes(items[2:7]))]    full_opt = torch.optim.SGD(full.parameters(), lr=.05)    accumulated_opt = torch.optim.SGD(accumulated.parameters(), lr=.05)    train_window(full, full_opt, [whole])    train_window(accumulated, accumulated_opt, parts)    grad_difference = parameter_difference = 0.    for reference, actual in zip(full.parameters(), accumulated.parameters()):        torch.testing.assert_close(actual.grad, reference.grad, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)        grad_difference = max(grad_difference, (actual.grad - reference.grad).abs().max().item())        parameter_difference = max(parameter_difference, (actual - reference).abs().max().item())    # 故意错误的控制组：局部 mean 再除微批次数，使短微批次过度加权。    for part in parts:        total, count = masked_error_sum(wrong, wrong(part["x"], part["valid"]), part)        (total / count / len(parts)).backward()    wrong_difference = max((p.grad - q.grad).abs().max().item()                           for p, q in zip(wrong.parameters(), full.parameters()))    assert wrong_difference > 1e-3    return {"valid_counts": [int(part["valid"].sum()) * 2 for part in parts],            "gradient_max_abs_error": grad_difference,            "parameter_max_abs_error": parameter_difference,            "wrong_local_mean_gradient_error": wrong_difference}  # 05 相同输入、初值、目标：单独改变算子精度，核对 dtype 和数值差别。def verify_cpu_amp(model, batch):    plain, mixed = copy.deepcopy(model), copy.deepcopy(model)    losses, grads = [], []    for current, enabled in [(plain, False), (mixed, True)]:        with amp_context(enabled):            prediction = current(batch["x"], batch["valid"])        total, count = masked_error_sum(current, prediction, batch)        loss = total / count        loss.backward()        assert prediction.dtype == (torch.bfloat16 if enabled else torch.float32)        assert loss.dtype == torch.float32        assert all(p.dtype == p.grad.dtype == torch.float32 for p in current.parameters())        losses.append(loss.detach().item())        grads.append(torch.cat([p.grad.flatten() for p in current.parameters()]))    relative_error = float((grads[0] - grads[1]).norm() / grads[0].norm())    assert relative_error < .03  # 仅约束这个小例子；并非任意模型的 BF16 误差界。    updated = copy.deepcopy(model)    result = train_window(updated, torch.optim.SGD(updated.parameters(), lr=.05),                          [batch], cpu_amp=True)    assert result["update_norm"] > 0    return {"fp32_loss": losses[0], "cpu_bf16_loss": losses[1],            "gradient_relative_error": relative_error,            "parameter_gradient_dtype": "float32", "autocast_output_dtype": "bfloat16",            "cpu_amp_update_norm": result["update_norm"]}  # 06 诊断：同一个 Batch 中无效 NaN 被隔离；有效 NaN 必须立即拒绝。def verify_masks(model, batch):    x = batch["x"].clone().requires_grad_()    baseline = model(x, batch["valid"])    zero_pad = batch["x"].masked_fill(~batch["valid"][..., None], 0)    torch.testing.assert_close(model(zero_pad, batch["valid"]), baseline)    total, count = masked_error_sum(model, baseline, batch)    dx, = torch.autograd.grad(total / count, x)    assert torch.isfinite(dx).all() and torch.count_nonzero(dx[~batch["valid"]]) == 0    poisoned = {key: value.clone() if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) else value                for key, value in batch.items()}    poisoned["y"][0, 0, 0] = float("nan")    try:        masked_error_sum(model, baseline, poisoned)    except ValueError:        pass    else:        raise AssertionError("有效 NaN 标签不应被静默跳过")    return {"valid_elements": count, "padding_input_gradient": 0,            "invalid_label_rejected": True}  def verify_optimizer_diagnosis(model, batch):    # 只改变优化器成员；相同模型、数据和 loss 仍能产生 bias 梯度。    broken = copy.deepcopy(model)    optimizer = torch.optim.SGD([broken.head.weight], lr=.05)    members = {id(p) for group in optimizer.param_groups for p in group["params"]}    old_bias = broken.head.bias.detach().clone()    broken.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    total, count = masked_error_sum(broken, broken(batch["x"], batch["valid"]), batch)    (total / count).backward()    optimizer.step()    assert broken.head.bias.grad is not None    assert broken.head.bias.grad.norm() > 0    assert id(broken.head.bias) not in members    torch.testing.assert_close(broken.head.bias, old_bias, rtol=0, atol=0)    return {"bias_has_gradient": True, "bias_in_optimizer": False,            "bias_update_norm": 0., "diagnosis": "optimizer_omits_parameter"}  # 07 checkpoint：限制在 epoch 边界，保存 sampler generator 和优化状态。def save_training(model, optimizer, scheduler, generator, epoch, update_step):    stream = io.BytesIO()    torch.save({"model": model.state_dict(), "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),                "scheduler": scheduler.state_dict(), "torch_rng": torch.get_rng_state(),                "loader_rng": generator.get_state(), "epoch": epoch,                "update_step": update_step, "data_revision": "toy-episodes-v1",                "boundary": "epoch_end", "cpu_amp": False}, stream)    return stream.getvalue()  def assert_state_equal(left, right):    if isinstance(left, torch.Tensor):        torch.testing.assert_close(left, right, rtol=0, atol=0)    elif isinstance(left, dict):        assert left.keys() == right.keys()        for key in left:            assert_state_equal(left[key], right[key])    elif isinstance(left, (tuple, list)):        assert len(left) == len(right)        for a, b in zip(left, right):            assert_state_equal(a, b)    else:        assert left == right  def main():    torch.set_num_threads(1)    torch.manual_seed(213)    dataset = ToyEpisodes()    train_items, validation_items = dataset.items[:32], dataset.items[32:]    assert set(item["id"] for item in train_items).isdisjoint(        item["id"] for item in validation_items)    statistics = fit_statistics(train_items)    model = TokenRegressor(statistics)    assert sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) == 10    probe = collate_episodes(train_items[:7])    evidence = {"mask": verify_masks(model, probe),                "accumulation": verify_accumulation(model, train_items),                "cpu_amp": verify_cpu_amp(model, probe),                "diagnosis": verify_optimizer_diagnosis(model, probe)}    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(217)    loader = make_loader(train_items, generator, shuffle=True)    val_loader = make_loader(validation_items, torch.Generator().manual_seed(219), False)    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=.04, weight_decay=0.)    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(optimizer, step_size=40, gamma=.8)    initial = evaluate(model, val_loader)    update_step = 0    for epoch in range(3):        result = train_epoch(model, optimizer, scheduler, loader, update_step)        update_step = result["update_step"]        assert sorted(result["order"]) == list(range(32))        assert result["count"] == sum(len(item["y"]) * 2 for item in train_items)    saved = save_training(model, optimizer, scheduler, generator, 3, update_step)    expected = train_epoch(model, optimizer, scheduler, loader, update_step)     # 构造操作可能消耗随机数，必须先构造/加载，最后恢复 RNG。    restored = TokenRegressor(statistics)    restored_opt = torch.optim.AdamW(restored.parameters(), lr=.04, weight_decay=0.)    restored_scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(restored_opt, step_size=40, gamma=.8)    restored_generator = torch.Generator()    state = torch.load(io.BytesIO(saved), weights_only=True, map_location="cpu")    assert state["data_revision"] == "toy-episodes-v1" and state["boundary"] == "epoch_end"    restored.load_state_dict(state["model"])    restored_opt.load_state_dict(state["optimizer"])    restored_scheduler.load_state_dict(state["scheduler"])    restored_generator.set_state(state["loader_rng"])    restored_loader = make_loader(train_items, restored_generator, True)    torch.set_rng_state(state["torch_rng"])    actual = train_epoch(restored, restored_opt, restored_scheduler,                         restored_loader, state["update_step"])    assert_state_equal(expected, actual)    assert_state_equal(model.state_dict(), restored.state_dict())    assert_state_equal(optimizer.state_dict(), restored_opt.state_dict())    assert_state_equal(scheduler.state_dict(), restored_scheduler.state_dict())    evidence["resume"] = {"next_epoch_identical": True, "saved_epoch": state["epoch"],                          "saved_update_step": state["update_step"],                          "next_update_step": actual["update_step"]}    update_step = actual["update_step"]    for _ in range(20):        result = train_epoch(restored, restored_opt, restored_scheduler,                             restored_loader, update_step)        update_step = result["update_step"]    final = evaluate(restored, val_loader)    assert final < initial * .02    evidence["training"] = {"initial_validation_normalized_mse": initial,                            "final_validation_normalized_mse": final,                            "optimizer_updates": update_step,                            "valid_training_scalars_per_epoch": result["count"]}    evidence["scope"] = {"device": "cpu", "torch": str(torch.__version__),                         "workers": 0, "restore_boundary": "epoch_end",                         "cuda_amp": "not_run", "real_ddp": "environment_blocked"}    print(json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))  if __name__ == "__main__":    main()
